First, we calculate $P(A\cup B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\  & =0.4+0.5-0.2 \\  & =0.7\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we construct the corresponding Venn diagram and shade the region $A\cap {B}^{′}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14041480/assets/52a7c0ed9285d2699087f0ef817257eacebfabd5cfb2117167730a66b94da3e6.png)

Finally, we have

$$
P(A\cap {B}^{′})=0.2.
$$
